name: Before Winter Ends
source:
Before Winter Ends invites you to step into the mystical realm of the Dark Forest, where every choice shapes the unfolding narrative of Ame and Fenrir's captivating journey. Immerse yourself in a rich tapestry of lush landscapes, mythical creatures, and enigmatic characters.

Your decisions become the threads weaving the fabric of Ame's and Fenrir's destinies. Traverse the ancient groves and encounter magical beings as you guide Ame, a child with a forgotten past, and Fenrir, the guardian wolf, through the mysteries of the Dark Forest.

Embark on this unforgettable visual novel adventure, where the echoes of your decisions resonate through the ancient trees, shaping the fates of those who dwell within the enchanting world before the winter ends.

[From [url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/before-winter-ends]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《冬日结束前》邀请你走进黑暗森林的神秘王国，其中的每一个选择都会塑造艾梅和芬里尔迷人旅程的展开叙事。沉浸在郁郁葱葱的风景、神秘的生物和神秘的人物的丰富织锦中。

你的决定成为编织艾梅和芬里尔命运的线索。当你引导一个被遗忘的过去的孩子艾梅和守护狼芬里尔穿越黑暗森林的奥秘时，穿越古老的树林并遇到神奇的生物。

踏上这场令人难忘的视觉小说冒险，你的决定的回声会在古老的树木中产生共鸣，在冬季结束之​​前塑造居住在这个迷人世界中的人们的命运。

[来自[url=https://chanchangames.itch.io/before-winter-ends]itch.io[/url]]
